blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte visits Fort Pilar Shrine in Zamboanga City, where she prayed for peace in the Philippines and the safe return of her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, from ICC detention in The Hague. —Photo from Inday Sara/Facebook MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte offered prayers for the safe return of her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, to the Philippines during a visit to the historic Fort Pilar Shrine in Zamboanga City. In a social media post on Sunday, Duterte said she also prayed for peace and order in the country while lighting candles and giving thanks for […]...
